The Windows drag/drop test executable embeds the x64 vcruntime140.dll,
extracted unmodified from Microsoft's official Visual C++ redistributable.
Copyright Microsoft Corporation. This component is not covered by the Dufs licenses.

Official package:
https://download.visualstudio.microsoft.com/download/pr/ebdab8e5-1d7b-4d9f-a11b-cbb1720c3b12/843068991DAAA1F73AD9F6239BCE4D0F6A07A51F18C37EA2A867E9BECA71295C/VC_redist.x64.exe

Runtime SHA256:

Microsoft redistribution documentation and terms:
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/redistributing-visual-cpp-files

This disposable test package is prepared for testing on the user's own Windows PC.
Production distribution and runtime updates require separate release preparation.
